proposed_widenings.name: retarget_incoming_attack
proposed_widenings.justification: The curse deterministically changes the defender of an already-targeted ranged-weapon attack. The current surface can grant resistance, block targeting, or negate effects, but it cannot redirect an incoming attack from one creature to another.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever an attack with a Ranged weapon targets a creature within 10 feet of you, the curse causes you to become the target instead.

notes: Authored subset captures only the held-shield resistance. The curse retargeting rider is omitted and proposed as an atom widening. `pnpm typecheck` failed due a pre-existing tracer bug at src/interpreter/tracer.ts:3274 (string[] passed where a string edge target is expected), but the new item JSON compiled and the tracer ran successfully.
